$schema_note: Stats are per-hit unless noted. dps = damage * attack_speed. effective_dps folds in crits: dps * (1 + crit_chance * (crit_multiplier - 1)). Passive effects are on top of that.

epic.label: Epic
epic.notes: Roughly 35x the price of the common in its class for ~2.8x the effective DPS, plus a passive with a utility angle (range, pierce, chain, poison).

legendary.label: Legendary
legendary.notes: Roughly 50x the price for ~3.4x the effective DPS, plus a passive that changes how the weapon plays.

weapons.name: Iron Sword
weapons.flavor: Dependable, dull, and always for sale.

weapons.name: Iron Dagger
weapons.flavor: Quick in the hand, short on reach.

weapons.name: Short Bow
weapons.flavor: Yew and gut string. Keeps you out of arm's reach.

weapons.name: Oak Staff
weapons.flavor: A walking stick that has seen one too many spells.

weapons.name: Voidreaver

passive.name: Void Rend
passive.description: Every hit shreds 15% of the target's armor for 4s. Stacks up to 3 times.

weapons.flavor: Obsidian split by a seam of nothing. It hums when it is hungry.

weapons.name: Solaris Blade

passive.name: Sunfire
passive.description: 20% chance per hit to ignite the target: 8 damage per second for 3s.

weapons.flavor: Forged at noon on midsummer. The fuller never stops glowing.

weapons.name: Frostbite

passive.name: Frostbite
passive.description: Critical hits slow the target by 40% for 2s.

weapons.flavor: Quenched in a glacier. The edge is so cold it never dulls.

weapons.name: Stormcaller

passive.name: Chain Lightning

weapons.flavor: Ash shaft, sky-iron head, and a temper to match.

weapons.name: Inferno Maul

passive.name: Eruption

weapons.flavor: The head was never cast. It was pulled, still burning, from the mountain.

weapons.name: Dragonbone Bow

passive.name: Piercing Shot
passive.description: Arrows pass through up to 2 enemies.

weapons.flavor: Strung with sinew from the same dragon. The skull still watches the arrow.

passive.name: Venom

weapons.name: Astral Scepter

passive.name: Arcane Echo
passive.description: Spells have a 25% chance to cast twice.

weapons.flavor: The orb is a captured star. It is not happy about it.
